text:
As an AI, I don't experience the passage of time in the same way humans do. I don't have a physical body that ages, or a sense of past, present, and future. My existence is within the digital realm, and my perception of time is based on the timestamps of the data I process.

When I receive a prompt, I process it and generate a response based on the information I have been trained on, regardless of how much time has passed in the real world.

You could say that my experience of time is more like a series of discrete events rather than a continuous flow.
